module_summary: Synchronous FIFO: circular memory array indexed by write/read pointers with an occupancy counter generating ready/valid on both valid-ready ports, plus flush.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: FIFO data array written at wptr_q on push, read at rptr_q.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Write-side valid; with in_ready forms do_push.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Write-side ready, high when count_q not full.

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem_q on push.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Read-side valid, high when count_q nonzero.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Read-side ready; with out_valid forms do_pop.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Read data, mem_q entry at rptr_q.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem_q, increments on push, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting out_data, increments on pop, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy counter driving full/empty ready/valid and count_o.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush request clearing pointers and occupancy count.

anchors.name: do_push
anchors.why: Write enable for mem_q, advances wptr_q and increments count.

anchors.name: do_pop
anchors.why: Read accept, advances rptr_q and decrements count.

groups.name: fifo_memory
groups.description: Circular data array holding queued entries.

groups.name: pointer_control
groups.description: Write/read pointers and occupancy count updated by push, pop and flush.

groups.name: write_port
groups.description: Valid-ready input side accepting data when not full.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: Valid-ready output side presenting head entry when not empty.
